recipes.title: Street Cart-Style Chicken Bowls
recipes.description: Spiced chicken and zucchini over jasmine rice with a bright lime sauce, served with a simple salad kit
ingredients: 12 oz boneless skinless chicken, bite-size pieces
1 simple salad kit, served without dressing for one portion
steps: Cook 1 cup jasmine rice according to package directions and keep covered.
Season chicken with cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir together sour cream, juice from half the lime, and 1–2 tsp water for a quick sauce.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken until browned and cooked through, about 6–8 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add zucchini to the same skillet and cook until browned-tender, about 5–6 minutes.
Divide rice between bowls and add chicken and zucchini. Drizzle with the lime sauce and remaining cilantro.
Serve with a simple salad kit on the side; use the included dressing only on the portion that wants it.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchiladas with Tomatillo Sauce
recipes.description: Two bubbling enchiladas with tomatillo sauce and melted cheese, with roasted corn and zucchini
ingredients: Use the linked original recipe for exact enchilada ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Prepare the enchiladas using the linked original recipe as your primary guide.
Use about 2 cups cooked shredded chicken for the filling; this can come from the chicken purchased for the week.
Assemble enchiladas with chicken, tomatillo sauce, tortillas, and cheese according to the original recipe.
Toss corn and sliced zucchini with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan.
Bake the enchiladas until hot and bubbling; roast the vegetables alongside until browned-tender.
Rest enchiladas 5 minutes before serving. Plate with the roasted corn and zucchini.

recipes.title: Chicken Sausage Rigatoni with Mushrooms & Zucchini
recipes.description: Rigatoni with browned chicken sausage, cremini mushrooms and zucchini in tomato sauce with Parmesan
steps: Bring a pot of well-salted water to a boil. Slice the sausage, zucchini and mushrooms; mince the garlic.
Cook rigatoni until al dente. Reserve ½ cup pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown sausage 4–5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and zucchini. Cook 5–7 minutes until browned-tender; add garlic for the final 30 seconds.
Add marinara and Italian seasoning. Simmer 3–4 minutes.
Add rigatoni and Parmesan. Toss, adding a splash of pasta water if needed to make the sauce glossy.
Serve hot with extra Parmesan if desired.

recipes.title: Trader Joe’s Mandarin Orange Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy glazed orange chicken over rice with bright green broccoli
ingredients: 1 package Trader Joe’s Mandarin Orange Chicken
steps: Start 1 cup rice according to package directions.
Cook Mandarin Orange Chicken according to package directions, keeping the sauce separate until the chicken is crisp.
While it cooks, heat 1 tsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add broccoli and optional bell pepper.
Cook vegetables 5–7 minutes until crisp-tender. Add 1–2 Tbsp water and cover briefly if you prefer softer broccoli.
Toss the hot chicken with its orange sauce.
Serve chicken over rice with a generous portion of broccoli and peppers.

recipes.title: Homemade Uncured Pepperoni Pizza
recipes.description: Golden thin-crust pizza with melted mozzarella and uncured pepperoni beside a fresh salad
ingredients: Optional leftover bell pepper or onion, thinly sliced
steps: Take pizza dough out of the refrigerator 20–30 minutes before shaping. Heat oven as hot as practical, ideally 475–500°F, with a sheet pan or pizza stone preheating.
On a lightly floured surface, stretch dough into a 12–14 inch round or oval.
Spread with pizza sauce, leaving a border. Add mozzarella, then a full base layer of uncured pepperoni. Add optional vegetables.
Transfer to the hot pan or stone. Bake until crust is browned and cheese is bubbling, usually 10–14 minutes.
While pizza bakes, toss the salad kit.
Rest pizza 2–3 minutes, slice, and serve with salad.

recipes.title: Argentine-Style Chicken & Chimichurri
recipes.description: Seared chicken with bright chimichurri, charred sweet corn and browned zucchini
ingredients: ½ cup packed fresh parsley, finely chopped
steps: Make chimichurri: combine parsley, garlic, red wine vinegar, 2 Tbsp olive oil, oregano, red pepper flakes and a pinch of salt.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat a large skillet or grill pan over medium-high.
Cook chicken until browned and 165°F in the center, about 5–7 minutes per side depending on thickness. Rest 5 minutes.
While chicken cooks, brush corn and zucchini lightly with the remaining olive oil; season with salt and pepper.
Char corn and zucchini in a hot skillet or grill pan until browned and tender, turning as needed, about 8–10 minutes.
Slice chicken and spoon chimichurri over the top. Serve with charred corn and zucchini.

recipes.title: BBQ Meatloaf & Loaded Potato Wedges
recipes.description: Glazed individual meatloaf with cheesy potato wedges and roasted carrots
ingredients: ¼ cup BBQ sauce, plus more for glazing
¼ cup shredded cheese for potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Line a sheet pan for easy cleanup.
Toss potato wedges and carrots with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Arrange on the sheet pan and begin roasting.
Mix ground meat, panko, egg, onion powder, 2 Tbsp BBQ sauce, ½ tsp salt, and pepper just until combined. Form into two small loaves.
After vegetables have roasted about 10 minutes, add meatloaves to the pan (or use a second small pan). Brush tops with BBQ sauce.
Roast until meatloaves are cooked through and vegetables are tender, about 20–25 more minutes.
Sprinkle cheese over hot potato wedges and return to oven for 1–2 minutes to melt.
Rest meatloaf 5 minutes. Serve with loaded wedges, sour cream, roasted carrots, and extra BBQ sauce if desired.

recipes.title: Kirkland Signature Chicken Street Tacos
recipes.description: Costco chicken street taco kit with seasoned chicken, tortillas, slaw, cheese, salsa and cilantro-lime crema
ingredients: Leftover Kirkland Signature Chicken Street Tacos kit, enough for 2
Use the kit’s tortillas, chicken, slaw, cheese, salsa and cilantro-lime crema
steps: Reheat the leftover chicken until steaming hot.
Warm tortillas briefly in a dry skillet or microwave.
Set out the slaw, cheese, salsa and cilantro-lime crema from the kit.
Build tacos with warm chicken and toppings. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Turkey Burgers with Tomato-Cucumber Salad & Corn
recipes.description: Juicy seasoned turkey burgers on toasted buns with a crisp tomato-cucumber salad and sweet corn
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey (form 2 large patties; or make 3 and freeze 1)
¼ small red onion, thinly sliced
1 Tbsp mayonnaise or preferred burger sauce
steps: Dice half the tomato and the cucumber; thinly slice red onion. Toss with 1 tsp olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt and pepper. Slice the remaining tomato for the burgers.
Mix ground turkey gently with Worcestershire, garlic powder, onion powder, ½ tsp salt and pepper. Form two large patties (or three smaller patties and freeze one uncooked).
Heat a skillet or grill pan over medium-high with a light film of oil. Cook patties 5–6 minutes per side until browned and 165°F in the center.
At the same time, cook corn in a hot skillet/grill pan, turning until tender and lightly charred, about 8–10 minutes.
Toast buns cut-side down for 1–2 minutes.
Build burgers with sauce, lettuce if using, sliced tomato and turkey patties. Serve with tomato-cucumber salad and corn.

recipes.title: Chicken & Mushroom Pot Pies
recipes.description: Morgan family chicken pot pies with poached chicken, carrots, leek, cremini mushrooms, corn and a creamy thyme gravy under flaky Pillsbury crust
ingredients: About 2 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 large leek, trimmed, quartered lengthwise and sliced
1 cup Silk Dairy-Free Heavy Whipping Cream
1 tsp minced fresh thyme leaves (or ½ tsp dried thyme)
Kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
1 large egg, beaten with 1 tsp warm water
steps: Poach chicken gently in simmering water until cooked through, about 15 minutes. Cool slightly, then shred into bite-size pieces; you want about 3 cups.
Heat oven to 400°F. In a wide saucepan over medium heat, cook carrots and leek in 1 Tbsp butter plus olive oil, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 15 minutes. Add garlic near the end.
Add mushrooms and cook, stirring, until tender and their moisture has cooked off, about 8–10 minutes. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a bowl.
Melt the remaining butter in the saucepan. Sprinkle in flour and whisk until smooth; cook a few minutes to remove the raw-flour taste.
Slowly whisk in chicken broth until smooth, then whisk in Silk heavy cream. Simmer until thick and gravy-like.
Return chicken and vegetables to the sauce. Stir in corn and thyme. Season well with salt and black pepper.
Divide filling among 4 oven-safe individual pot-pie dishes or ramekins. Cut refrigerated pie crust to fit each dish with a small overhang.
Lay crust over each pie, crimp the edges, cut a few vents, and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 400°F until the crust is deeply golden and the filling is bubbling, about 25–30 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Beef Taco Bowls
recipes.description: Seasoned ground beef with rice, black beans, peppers, zucchini, salsa and cheese
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Start ¾ cup rice according to package directions.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add ground beef, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Cook 6–8 minutes, breaking it apart, until browned and cooked through.
Add bell pepper and zucchini to the beef skillet. Cook 5–7 minutes until crisp-tender and lightly browned.
Warm the black beans in a small saucepan or microwave until hot.
Build bowls with rice, beef and vegetables, black beans, salsa and shredded cheese.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and serve hot.

recipes.title: Trader Joe’s Kung Pao Chicken + Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.description: Trader Joe’s Kung Pao Chicken with easy vegetable fried rice and crisp-tender broccoli
ingredients: 1 package Trader Joe’s Kung Pao Chicken
1 bag Trader Joe’s Vegetable Fried Rice
steps: Preheat a large skillet according to the package directions for the Kung Pao Chicken.
Cook the Kung Pao Chicken according to package directions, keeping the sauce separate until the chicken is crisp.
In a second skillet, heat the vegetable fried rice over medium-high, stirring occasionally, until hot and steaming.
While the frozen items cook, heat 1 tsp oil in the first skillet or a third pan. Add broccoli and 1–2 Tbsp water, cover for 2 minutes, then uncover and cook until crisp-tender.
Toss the hot chicken with its sauce and stir the fried rice once more.
Serve Kung Pao Chicken with vegetable fried rice and a generous portion of broccoli.

recipes.title: Aidells Chicken & Apple Sausage Sheet-Pan Dinner
recipes.description: Roasted chicken & apple sausage with baby potatoes, carrots and zucchini
ingredients: 1 package Aidells Chicken & Apple Sausage (4 links)
3 medium carrots, peeled and cut into chunks
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Halve the baby potatoes, cut the carrots into chunks, and slice the zucchini.
Toss potatoes and carrots with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper on a sheet pan. Roast for 15 minutes.
Add the sliced Aidells chicken & apple sausage and zucchini to the pan. Toss with the roasting vegetables.
Roast 12–15 minutes more, until the potatoes are tender, carrots are browned, zucchini is tender, and sausage is heated through.
Broil for 1–2 minutes if you want extra browning, watching closely.
Divide between two plates and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Kirkland Signature Cauliflower-Crust Supreme Pizza
recipes.description: Kirkland Signature supreme cauliflower-crust pizza with pepperoni, sausage, roasted vegetables and a three-cheese blend
ingredients: 1 Kirkland Signature Cauliflower Crust Pizza, Supreme (19.4 oz)
Optional: 1 salad kit, served without dressing for one portion
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Keep the pizza frozen while the oven preheats.
Remove the pizza from its overwrap and cardboard. Place the frozen pizza directly on the center oven rack; do not use a baking sheet.
Bake for 17–19 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown. For convection, bake at 425°F for 14–16 minutes.
Let the pizza rest for 2–3 minutes, then slice and serve. Add a salad kit on the side if desired.
